prompt.alinti: Stop losing your important medical paperwork in a messy drawer.
We've all dealt with that frustration of hunting for an old prescription or a blood test result right when we really need it.
This app, called Cura, acts like a digital filing cabinet for your health records that lives right on your phone.
You just snap a photo of any bill, lab report, or doctor's note, and the app reads the information, organizes everything by date, and even flags if your results are high or low.
It's basically like having a personal assistant who remembers every single doctor visit for you, so you can stop guessing about your history or digging through stacks of paper.
The best part is that it's completely private, because it does all the work directly on your device, without sending your sensitive data to some random server.
If you want, it can even help answer questions about your records, but that's totally optional.
It's a clever way to keep your health details clear and searchable without giving up your privacy.
Right now this project has zero stars on GitHub.
Check out the project on GitHub to see how it works.
